role: execution provenance linkage — NOT a methodological gate

invariant.statement: PRE_CHECK, AT_RESUME, pause and result digests are all four distinct and immutable
invariant.why_distinct: a shared path would have let one supersede another, and the history would read as a single gate revised over time rather than four separate events
invariant.why_immutable: the chain is evidence only if none of its links can be rewritten after the fact

authorization_vs_issuance.rule: a PASS is not an issuance. PRE_CHECK can never authorise a resume; only the contemporaneous AT_RESUME gate can, and the signal is recorded as sent only when it was actually sent.

result_completeness.rule: 60/60 base worlds AND 360/360 cells. Worlds alone is not completeness — a world missing lanes would still count as a world.

cell_invariant.rule: a base world is in the ledger with all six lanes, or not at all

execution_pause.reason: resource isolation — the app and the GANN capability needed the machine

code_provenance_binding: the result binds LAUNCH-TIME module digests, captured while the running process was still their only reader — never the resume-time working tree
outcome_exposure: NOT_EXPOSED — this module reads digests and execution metadata; it selects no detection value
